ios.desc:
Master Korean Typing | Type Like a Native!

Unlock the power of Korean typing with our cutting-edge app, designed to help you type faster and more accurately in Hangul. Whether you’re a Korean beginner or looking to refine your skills, this is the perfect practice tool for you!

Why Choose Our Korean Typing App?

	• Real-Time Typing Practice – Enhance your typing speed with interactive exercises.
	• Learn Hangul Easily – No need for a separate Korean keyboard; our app includes a built-in Korean keyboard.
	• Instant Feedback – Identify mistakes, improve accuracy, and confidently type.
	• Minimalist & Intuitive Design – No distractions, just pure Korean learning.
	• Fun & Engaging Challenges – Test your skills with fun exercises and daily practice.

Who Is This App For?

	• Korean learners wanting to master Hangul typing
	• K-pop & K-drama fans who want to text in Korean
	• Students preparing for TOPIK (Test of Proficiency in Korean)
	• Travelers & ex-pats looking to communicate better in Korea
	• Anyone who wants to type in Korean like a pro!

Start your Hangul typing journey today! Download now and practice Korean typing effortlessly!

quotes.text:
I’ve been working on a couple of apps over the past few months, and I’d love to share them with you

Type Korean is all about helping people get used to typing on a Korean keyboard. When I first moved to South Korea in March last year. I ran into an issue with typing on the Korean keyboard, I was super slow, which can be annoying when trying to search for something in Korean.
